body: Manish Mohnot (MD & CEO) on 2025-08-08 (Q1FY26 concall transcript): "We are progressing well on approval for sale of Vindhyachal Expressway and expect to complete the transaction in Q3 of '25/'26" Metric: Asset sale closing. Target: by 31-Dec-25. Deadline: 2025-12-31. Specificity: precise; volunteered. Status as of 2026-11-21: partly. Evidence: Completed January 2026 (EV ~INR 799 cr, net cash >INR 600 cr): one quarter late; Oct-25 had already widened to 'second half'.
